## History

Carrie Mott was a local girl whose father shared Thirza's restrictive views on young girls attending evening concerts, prohibiting her from going to such events.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P33](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0033)_
